mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, phase, slots, last_recommendations, version, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_messages (session_id, role, content, intent, agent_trace_id, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{intent}, #{traceId}, NOW())

INSERT INTO diet_messages (session_id, role, content, intent, agent_trace_id, client_msg_id, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{intent}, #{traceId}, #{clientMsgId}, NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.session_id, m.role, m.content, m.intent, m.agent_trace_id, m.created_at FROM diet_messages m INNER JOIN diet_sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id AND s.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
